## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Include a before/after
example when helpful.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Identify skipped checks, fixture-only
coverage and any live qualification still needed. Do not include credentials or
private library data.

## Compatibility and documentation

Note migration, configuration, file identity or recovery implications. Link the
updated guide/changelog when behavior changes. Keep stable publication and live
deployment separate from code and build validation.
